acceptance_criteria.criterion: ComicsFilter::setSearchText('foo') causes isMatch() to reject comics whose label and synopsis do not contain 'foo' (case-insensitive)
Setting search text to '' disables search filtering — all comics pass the search check
SessionComicsFilter::importValues() restores the search text from session data
SessionComicsFilter::getValues() includes the search text for session storage
PHPStan passes with no new errors after these changes

summary: Added FILTER_SEARCH constant and searchText property to ComicsFilter. Added setSearchText() method with trimming. Updated reset() to clear searchText. Updated isMatch() to filter by search text using mb_stripos() against label and synopsis. Updated SessionComicsFilter::importValues() to restore search text from session. Updated SessionComicsFilter::getValues() to persist search text. PHPStan passes with no new errors. All 60 tests pass.

comments.note: ComicsFilter::isMatch() is declared private, which prevents subclasses from extending filter logic. If additional filter types are added in the future, this method should be protected. Not blocking for current scope.
SessionComicsFilter places FILTER_STATUS constant on the child class rather than ComicsFilter where the other FILTER_* constants live. Minor inconsistency — not blocking for this WP.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified — implementation is correct and complete.
Build & Runtime: PHP 8.4 syntax valid, no parse errors.
Regression: All 60 tests pass (0 failures, 1 skip, 1 deprecation — both pre-existing). No regressions introduced.
AC1 confirmed via code inspection: isMatch() uses mb_stripos() with AND logic against label+synopsis, gated by non-empty searchText check.
AC2 confirmed: if($this->searchText !== '') gate correctly skips filtering when empty.
AC4 confirmed: importValues() calls setSearchText() from session data after reset().
AC5 confirmed: getValues() includes FILTER_SEARCH => $this->searchText in returned array.
Edge cases verified: whitespace-only input trimmed to '' (filtering disabled); comics with empty synopsis handled safely by mb_stripos; Unicode-safe mb_stripos() used correctly.

comments.note: No dedicated unit tests were added for the new search filter functionality (setSearchText, isMatch with search text, reset clearing searchText). isMatch() is declared private, echoing the developer's own note. This prevents SessionComicsFilter or any future subclass from extending filter logic. Consider making it protected in a future refactor.

summary: Code review PASS. Implementation is clean, correct, and follows project conventions. No blocking issues found.

ComicsFilter: FILTER_SEARCH constant correctly placed on base class alongside FILTER_ORDER_BY/FILTER_ORDER_DIR. searchText property initialized to '' (no null-state). setSearchText() properly trims and returns $this (fluent API). reset() correctly clears searchText. isMatch() OR-logic is semantically correct — comic passes if search text appears in label OR synopsis. mb_stripos() is the right choice: Unicode-safe, case-insensitive, no locale issues. The if($this->searchText !== '') guard is clean and correct.

SessionComicsFilter: importValues() correctly chains reset() → selectStatus() → setOrderDir() → setSearchText(), ensuring trimming is applied on session restore. getValues() correctly includes FILTER_SEARCH. No regressions introduced.
Security: no injection risk, no XSS surface, type safety confirmed by PHPStan level 5 (0 errors). Performance: mb_stripos() twice per comic is appropriate for a local/LAN context.
All 6 acceptance criteria fully implemented and confirmed by QA. 60/60 tests pass.

comments.note: ComicsFilter::isMatch() is declared private. This prevents SessionComicsFilter or any future subclass from customizing or extending matching logic. Consider changing visibility to protected in a future refactor. Non-blocking — current scope has no subclassing needs.

No dedicated unit tests were added for the new setSearchText/isMatch(search) behaviour. The WP acceptance criteria do not require new tests, so this is not a blocker. A ComicsFilterTest class covering setSearchText(), empty-string gate, reset() clearing searchText, and the OR-logic of label vs synopsis matching would significantly improve confidence for future changes.

Pre-existing: FILTER_STATUS is declared on SessionComicsFilter rather than on the base ComicsFilter class where all other FILTER_* constants live. This is out of scope for this WP but is worth consolidating in a future housekeeping pass.
